process.title: Post-NCC 1978 recording, editing and television distribution

step.label: Source detail 1
step.description: scope: Every Logix presentation at NCC 1978, including the premiere, both technical sessions, partner appearances, questions and any additional Logix sessions.

step.label: Source detail 2
step.description: production: Professional multi-camera crew with clean presenter audio, audience/reaction coverage and close-ups of the computer, screen, connections and printouts. Retain full-session recordings and production masters.

step.label: Source detail 3
step.description: deliverables / 0: Attractively edited broadcast feature with a clear business-user narrative

step.label: Source detail 4
step.description: deliverables / 1: Short station-ready news packages and demonstration excerpts

step.label: Source detail 5
step.description: deliverables / 2: Clean footage, separate narration/audio where practical, accurate captions and a factual product/Academy press sheet

step.label: Source detail 6
step.description: deliverables / 3: Full edited presentations for stations wanting longer technical coverage

step.label: Source detail 7
step.description: distribution: Offer and supply the material free of charge to any television station wishing to broadcast it; Logix covers normal duplication and dispatch. Supply station-compatible broadcast copies on request.

step.label: Source detail 8
step.description: broadcast fee usd: 0

step.label: Source detail 9
step.description: editorial policy: Station participation, scheduling and editorial selection are voluntary; no guaranteed airtime, compulsory advertising purchase or claimed editorial endorsement. Identify the material as supplied by Logix.

step.label: Source detail 10
step.description: rights: Arrange presenter, partner, music and production rights covering free television redistribution before recording. Michael Douglas commercial footage may be included only if separately cleared for this use.

step.label: Source detail 11
step.description: fidelity: Do not accelerate startup or recalculation, conceal failures through misleading cuts, or present pre-recorded footage as a live result. Identify edited excerpts and show only qualified claims.

step.label: Source detail 12
step.description: timing: Record throughout June 5–8; begin station outreach before NCC and distribute edited packages after the conference as edits and broadcast clearances are completed. Exact delivery dates and runtime remain production decisions.

step.label: Source detail 13
step.description: engineering: Qualify a custom Aurelia digital-video-to-projection/recording path; rehearse readability, lighting and sound in the hired room. Use a backup demonstration system and clearly identified recorded fallback.
